{'text': '經過長達三星期的罕見等待，Apple 今日終於推出 iOS 27 beta 5，今次更新為 Siri、Safari 等多個應用程式帶來全新圖示。', 'source': 'After an unusual three-week wait, Apple today released iOS 27 beta 5, bringing fresh icons to a range of apps including Siri and Safari.'}

{'text': 'Apple 於 iOS 27 beta 5 推出應用程式圖示更新', 'source': 'Apple rolls out app icon updates in iOS 27 beta 5'}

{'text': 'iOS 27 距離公開發布越來越近，預計下月推出。', 'source': 'iOS 27 is getting closer to public release, expected next month.'}

{'text': '今日發布的 beta 5 帶來多項面向用戶的改動，為正式推出做好準備。', 'source': "Today's beta 5 includes a number of user-facing changes ahead of the official launch."}

{'text': '其中，多個系統應用程式換上了新圖示：', 'source': 'Among them, several system apps have received new icons:'}

  • {'text': 'Siri', 'source': 'Siri'}
  • {'text': 'Safari', 'source': 'Safari'}
  • {'text': 'Preview', 'source': 'Preview'}
  • {'text': 'Settings', 'source': 'Settings'}
  • {'text': 'Remote', 'source': 'Remote'}

{'text': '你可以喺上面嘅圖片中睇到部分新圖示。亦有其他應用程式有非常細微嘅更新。', 'source': 'You can see some of the new icons in the images above. Other apps have also received very minor updates.'}

{'text': '自首個 beta 版本以嚟，iOS 27 已引入更多圖示設計改動，Apple 持續改良去年嘅 Liquid Glass 風格。', 'source': "Since the first beta, iOS 27 has introduced further icon design changes, as Apple continues refining last year's Liquid Glass style."}

{'text': 'Maps、Photos 及 Wallet 等應用程式自 iOS 27 開始測試以來已經採用新圖示。但今日 beta 5 嘅修訂顯示，Apple 對 iOS 27 圖示嘅調整尚未完成。', 'source': "Apps like Maps, Photos, and Wallet have already adopted new icons since iOS 27 began testing. But today's beta 5 revisions suggest Apple hasn't finished tweaking the iOS 27 icons."}

{'text': '你點睇 iOS 27 嘅最新應用程式圖示改動？歡迎喺留言區分享你嘅意見。', 'source': 'What do you think of the latest app icon changes in iOS 27? Let us know in the comments.'}
